_loader_notes: AGENTS.md B2: the 'How are you feeling today?' check-in at the top of the logger.
Only sessions.lighter_session (true/false) is saved. Never save, log or send which option she picked.

card.title: How are you feeling today?
card.helper: Pick one if you like. You can always skip this.
card.show_when: Before her first ticked set in a strength session, unless profiles.hide_checkin is true. Not shown for cardio or stretch sessions, or if she has already answered for this session.

lighter_offer.title: Lighter day? That still counts.
lighter_offer.body: We'll keep your main lift, take a set off the others and suggest slightly lighter weights. It's just for today.
lighter_offer.decline: No thanks, keep it as planned
lighter_offer.short_time_body: We'll keep your main lift and the key exercises, and take a set off the rest so you finish sooner. It's just for today.

lighter_rules.main_lift: Keep all sets. Suggested weight about 10% lower, rounded down to the nearest available increment, never below the bar or the lightest dumbbell.
lighter_rules.secondary_and_accessory: Remove one set (minimum 1 set). Suggested weight about 10% lower, rounded as above.
lighter_rules.core_and_finisher: Keep as planned, or let her skip with one tap.
lighter_rules.cardio_finisher: Offer a gentle swap: steady effort, same machine, same or shorter time.
lighter_rules.short_time: Same set changes, but keep suggested weights as normal.
lighter_rules.scope: Today only. Never changes the routine.
lighter_rules.progression: The progression rule ignores sessions where lighter_session is true and uses her last normal session for each exercise.
lighter_rules.streak: A lighter session counts fully towards the weekly target and streak.

settings.row_sub: Ask how I'm feeling before a session
